welcome.intro: Start with a clear view of what you have, what changed, and what needs your attention.

tour.promise: Understand NexStock's value without entering any data.
tour.overviewTitle: A complete reading, not just a count
tour.overviewMessage: NexStock turns inventory data into priorities, explanations, and safe simulations. These examples show what it reveals after inventory setup.

pulse.title: NexPulse
pulse.description: Summarizes inventory health in plain language and organizes priorities by urgency.
pulse.example: Example: two critical products and one priority replenishment.

products.title: Products and NexCode
products.description: Combines registration, search, filters, archiving, and sequential codes without losing history.
products.example: Example: Quantum SSD, code NX-SSD-0002, five units.

insight.title: Explainable insights
insight.description: Estimates coverage and confidence while showing data, calculations, and limitations without inventing forecasts.
insight.example: Example: estimated coverage of fifteen days with medium confidence.

scenario.title: Scenario Lab
scenario.description: Simulates entries, withdrawals, and minimum-stock changes without altering real inventory.
scenario.example: Example: withdrawing three units would change the status to critical.

profiles.title: Adaptive profiles
profiles.description: The same core supports technology, cosmetics, fashion, food, and custom operations.
profiles.example: Example: serial numbers for technology and expiry dates for food.

shield.title: NexShield and PWA
shield.description: Protects domain rules, keeps an audit trail, and supports local, installable, connection-resilient use.
shield.example: Example: negative inventory, duplicate codes, and dangerous URLs are blocked.

pulse.question: How is my inventory?

dashboardCore.noMovements: No movements have been recorded yet.
dashboardCore.radarMessage: {count} priorities were found, ordered from most to least urgent.
dashboardCore.insightsMessage: Review coverage estimates, confidence, inventory memory, and every calculation used.

confidence.low: Low confidence: there are fewer than five relevant events.
confidence.medium: Medium confidence: useful data exists, but volume or history is still limited.
confidence.high: High confidence: there are at least fifteen events over fourteen days or more. This remains an estimate.

explain.title: How did we calculate this?
explain.averageFormula: Daily average: {total} units divided by 30 days, result {average}.
explain.daysFormula: Coverage: {quantity} units divided by the daily average of {average}, approximate result {days} days.
explain.unavailableFormula: With no withdrawals in the period, the daily average is zero and coverage division cannot be calculated.

limitations.NO_OUTPUT_EVENTS: No withdrawal was recorded in the analysis window.
limitations.FEW_EVENTS: Few events can make the estimate unstable.
limitations.SHORT_HISTORY: The observed period is still shorter than fourteen days.
limitations.PAST_DEMAND_MAY_CHANGE: Future demand may change because of seasonality, purchases, losses, or business decisions.

insightCore.memoryDescription: Summary derived exclusively from recorded history.

memory.explainLimitation: Operations before the available local history cannot be reconstructed.
